text: The aim is self-service use of the established analysis workflow after the software and required resources have been set up. This is the design goal, not a measured usability claim. Explain: I wanted biologists to choose their data, configure the analysis and obtain outputs themselves, without waiting for someone else to execute each run. Approx. 1–2 minutes.

text: The updated diagram follows the user’s requested conceptual organization: one NanoTel workflow rather than a separately named R Analysis stage. The implementation language is not shown to the lab audience. Statistics shown are descriptive summaries that the existing project outputs: telomeric read counts, median telomere length and percentage below a configurable cutoff. text: Source: advanced_section.py. The modified-base choices are None, 5mCpG and 5mCpG + 5hmCpG. They are mutually exclusive. Choosing either modified-base mode automatically selects chromosome mapping and prevents unchecking it while the mode remains selected. Returning to None leaves mapping selected but allows it to be unchecked. Show the dependency as a helpful GUI behavior; do not claim fresh biological validation.

name: text-67
text: Combine modes, or leave all unselected to skip TVR patterns.

text: Source: advanced_section.py. TVR means telomere variant repeats. Preset uses organism-specific patterns, TSQ1 uses the TSQ1 pattern, and Manual accepts custom DNA patterns. These modes are independent and can be combined. None selected means no TVR patterns. TSQ1 initially enables one mismatch, which the user can clear unless Preset controls exact matching. The screenshot shows TSQ1 selected.

text: Source: advanced_section.py, workflow_section.py and saved configuration. Explain each control in user terms. Minimum read length is an input/filter threshold; edge distance and maximum telomere start govern proximity to read ends and start position. Minimum density is a repeat-density threshold. Short Telomere Cutoff controls the percentage reported below the selected length. The values shown are captured settings, not recommendations for every dataset. Trimming status can change effective values downstream.

Choose a fresh demo output directory; do not overwrite the saved demonstration run. 4. Choose the organism appropriate to the known dataset; confirm this before the meeting. 5.
